messages:
zoe_ops: quick follow-up from today's all-hands infra section — thanks for the walk-through! :clap:
zoe_ops: two clarifying Qs: (1) will we publish exact GPU SKU allocations per region? (2) how does the new autoscale behavior affect p99 for short, high-frequency spikes?

liam_infra: short answers: SKU allocations will be published as an "inventory ETA" in the console and status page. Primary Dedicated SKUs: H100/A100. Cheaper cards (T4/RTX class) will be used for embedding pools and fallbacks.

liam_infra: autoscale behavior: we keep a small warm pool per-region; default min_warm depends on cluster size (1-3). For normal spikes p95/p99 should remain stable. For extreme spikes (>8-10x) we route to preemptible burst capacity or gracefully fall back to quantized/smaller model variants to protect latency.

anya_sre: extra detail: warm-pool hit-rate is monitored and well add a dashboard tile. During the canary well run a 3x and 6x spike smoke test; rollback criteria: cold_start_rate > 5% sustained for 10m or p99 latency >500ms increase vs baseline.

jordan_product: can we show a small "Region ETA" badge in the reservation UI and a checkbox in signup: "Allow cross-region backfill if local capacity is unavailable"? We should also add a tooltip about latency implications.

liam_infra: yes. UI will show ETA + backfill toggle. Cross-region backfill is opt-in; for latency-sensitive SLAs we prefer model-variant fallback over cross-region routing. Billing for burst is metered where execution happens; cross-region bursts will appear in the console cost estimate.

deploy-bot: [deploy] autoscaler-v2 canary scheduled: 2026-10-05T03:00Z -> target 10% Dedicated clusters. Monitor: autoscale_events, p99_latency, cold_start_rate.

zoe_ops: thanks. last thing: will reserved commits get prioritization for warm pools? AE asks need clarity for sales materials.

liam_infra: reservations get allocation priority for the chosen region and warm-pool reservation until commit window starts. Well provide an internal inventory dashboard for AE/Sales Ops with read-only ETAs.

maya_ceo: product/infra to produce: (1) a short public FAQ for signup & console, (2) an internal one-pager for Sales, (3) a support brief. Target: EOD Friday. Keep language explicit about phased APAC rollouts to avoid churn.

jordan_product: Im on it. Ill draft the FAQ and post here for review.

anya_sre: note: creating a paging rule during rollout: cold_start_rate > 5% for 10m -> page oncall SRE.

deploy-bot: [alert] paging rule created: cold_start_rate > 5% for 10m -> page SRE oncall.
